IFC4.View_StructuralSurfaceAction: This entity defines an action which is distributed over a surface.
IFC4.View_StructuralSurfaceConnection: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.
IFC4.View_StructuralSurfaceMember: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.
IFC4.View_StructuralSurfaceReaction: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a surface.
IFC4.View_SubContractResource: IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a sub-contractor.
IFC4.View_SurfaceFeature: A surface feature is a modification at (onto, or into) of the surface of an element.
IFC4.View_SwitchingDevice: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.
IFC4.View_System: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.
IFC4.View_SystemFurnitureElement: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.
IFC4.View_Tank: A tank is a vessel or container in which a fluid or gas is stored for later use.
IFC4.View_Task: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out in a construction project.
IFC4.View_Tendon: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.
IFC4.View_TendonAnchor: A tendon anchor is the end connection for tendons in prestressed or posttensioned concrete.
IFC4.View_Transformer: A transformer is an inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.
IFC4.View_TransportElement: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a building or building complex.
IFC4.View_TubeBundle: An assembly of tubes used for heat transfer within equipment such as a chiller or coil.
IFC4.View_UnitaryControlElement: A unitary control element combines a number of control components into a single product, such as a thermostat or humidistat.
IFC4.View_UnitaryEquipment: Unitary equipment typically combine a number of components into a single product, such as air handlers, pre-packaged rooftop air-conditioning units, heat pumps, and split systems.
IFC4.View_Valve: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.
IFC4.View_VibrationIsolator: A vibration isolator is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration transmissibility in a building.
IFC4.View_VirtualElement: A virtual element is a special element used to provide imaginary boundaries, such as between two adjacent, but not separated, spaces.
IFC4.View_VoidingFeature: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume.
IFC4.View_Wall: The wall represents a vertical construction that bounds or subdivides spaces.
IFC4.View_WasteTerminal: A device that collects or intercepts waste from sanitary terminals or other equipment and discharges it into a drainage system.
IFC4.View_Window: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air.
IFC4.View_WorkCalendar: An IfcWorkCalendar defines working and non-working time periods for tasks and resources.
IFC4.View_WorkPlan: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.
IFC4.View_WorkSchedule: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule of a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.
IFC4.View_Zone: A zone is a group of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.

IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ActionRequest: A request is the act or instance of asking for something, such as a request for information, bid submission, or performance of work.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Actor: The IfcActor defines all actors or human agents involved in a project during its full life cycle.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Actuator: An actuator is a mechanical device for moving or controlling a mechanism or system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AirTerminal: An air terminal is a terminating or origination point for the transfer of air between distribution system(s) and one or more spaces.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AirTerminalBox: An HVAC device that regulates the amount of air supplied to downstream ductwork.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AirToAirHeatRecovery: An air-to-air heat recovery device employs a counter-flow heat exchanger between inbound and outbound air flow.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Alarm: A device that signals an abnormal condition or activates an alarm signal.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Alignment: Defines a reference system for linear positioning and the geometric layout of linear infrastructure, including horizontal, vertical, and cant layouts.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AlignmentCant: An IfcAlignmentCant is a lateral inclination profile defined along the horizontal alignment.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AlignmentHorizontal: An IfcAlignmentHorizontal is a linear reference projected onto the horizontal x/y plane.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AlignmentSegment: A portion of an alignment with a defined mathematical description of its horizontal direction, vertical direction, or railway cant.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AlignmentVertical: An IfcAlignmentVertical is a height profile along the horizontal alignment.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Annotation: An information element that adds notes or meaning to objects within the project's geometric and spatial context.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Asset: An identifiable group of elements treated as one asset with financial value.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_AudioVisualAppliance: An audio-visual appliance is a device that displays, captures, transmits, or receives audio or video.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Beam: An individual beam, usually horizontal or nearly horizontal. It is not necessarily load bearing.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Bearing: A support component that transfers loads between structural parts while usually allowing specified displacement or rotation.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Boiler: A pressure-rated vessel that heats water or another fluid using an energy source.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Borehole: A linear geological or geotechnical model that may assemble strata, capping, lining, and related elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Bridge: A civil structure providing passage above obstacles or between elevated points for people, animals, vehicles, or services.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Building: A structure intended to shelter occupants or contents and normally remain permanently in one place.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuildingElementPart: IfcBuildingElementPart represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuildingElementProxy: An element represented without a more specific predefined semantic class for the element it represents.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuildingStorey: The building storey has an elevation and typically represents a (nearly) horizontal aggregation of spaces that are vertically bound.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuildingSystem: A building system is a group by which building elements are grouped according to a common function within the facility.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuiltElement: The built element comprises all elements that are primarily part of the construction of a built facility, i.e., its structural and space separating system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_BuiltSystem: A built system is a group by which built elements are grouped according to a common function within the facility.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Burner: A burner is a device that converts fuel into heat through combustion.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CableCarrierFitting: A cable carrier fitting is a fitting that is placed at junction or transition in a cable carrier system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CableCarrierSegment: A cable carrier segment is a flow segment that is specifically used to carry and support cabling.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CableFitting: A cable fitting is a fitting that is placed at a junction, transition or termination in a cable system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CableSegment: A cable segment is a flow segment used to carry electrical power, data, or telecommunications signals.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CaissonFoundation: A foundation formed as an open or closed hollow box.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Chiller: A refrigeration device that removes heat from a liquid using a vapor-compression or absorption cycle.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Chimney: Chimneys are typically vertical, or as near as vertical, parts of the construction of a building and part of the building fabric.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CivilElement: An IfcCivilElement is a generalization of all elements within a civil engineering works that cannot be represented as BuildingElements, DistributionElements or GeographicElements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Coil: A coil is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Column: A vertical structural or architectural member, often located at an intersection of the structural grid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CommunicationsAppliance: A communications appliance transmits and receives electronic or digital information as data or sound.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Compressor: A compressor is a device that compresses a fluid typically used in a refrigeration circuit.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Condenser: A heat-rejection device that typically condenses a substance from gas to liquid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ConstructionEquipmentResource: IfcConstructionEquipmentResource is usage of construction equipment to assist in the performance of construction.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ConstructionMaterialResource: IfcConstructionMaterialResource identifies a material resource type in a construction project.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ConstructionProductResource: IfcConstructionProductResource defines the role of a product that is consumed (wholly or partially), or occupied in the performance of construction.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Controller: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ConveyorSegment: A continuous conveyor run connecting sections of a conveyor system, using a carrying mechanism such as a belt, chain, or screw.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CooledBeam: A chilled-beam device that cools room air by circulating fluid through exposed finned tubes above a space.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CoolingTower: A device that rejects heat to ambient air by circulating and partially evaporating a fluid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CostItem: A cost or financial value with contextual information, used as an item within a cost schedule.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CostSchedule: A collection of cost items for an estimate, bill of quantities, work order, or another cost-related presentation.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Course: A long, relatively thin layer of material laid on site over another horizontal or nearly horizontal built element.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Covering: A finishing or protective covering applied to a surface or element, such as flooring, ceiling, cladding, insulation, or roofing.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CrewResource: IfcCrewResource represents a collection of internal resources used in construction processes.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_CurtainWall: A wall assembly hung from the floor or roof structure rather than supported directly on a floor.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Damper: A damper typically participates in an HVAC duct distribution system and is used to control or modulate the flow of air.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DeepFoundation: Deep foundation is a type of foundation that transfers loads deeper than shallow foundation below the soft soils not capable of bearing the above structure.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DiscreteAccessory: A discrete accessory is a representation of different kinds of accessories included in or added to elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionBoard: A flow controller that groups electrical or communications devices at one location for a particular purpose.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionChamberElement: A distribution chamber element defines a place at which distribution systems and their constituent elements may be inspected or through which they may travel.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionCircuit: A distribution circuit is a partition of a distribution system that is conditionally switched such as an electrical circuit.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionControlElement: The distribution element IfcDistributionControlElement defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionElement: IfcDistributionElement is a generalization of all elements that participate in a distribution system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionFlowElement: The distribution element IfcDistributionFlowElement defines occurrence elements of a distribution system that facilitate the distribution of energy or matter, such as air, water or power.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionPort: A distribution port is an inlet or outlet of a product through which a particular substance may flow.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DistributionSystem: A distribution system is a network designed to receive, store, maintain, distribute, or control the flow of a distribution media.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Door: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DuctFitting: A junction or transition connecting duct segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DuctSegment: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_DuctSilencer: A device installed in ductwork to reduce noise from airflow or equipment in adjacent spaces or downstream ducts.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_EarthworksCut: The resulting void from modification of existing terrain or road structure by excavation or by other means of removing material.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_EarthworksElement: An element created by earthworks to form subgrade, raise ground levels, or reinforce or stabilize soil.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_EarthworksFill: A type of earthworks element created by earthwork activities to build subgrade or to raise the level of the ground in general.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricAppliance: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricDistributionBoard: A distribution board is a flow controller in which instances of electrical devices are brought together at a single place for a particular purpose.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricFlowStorageDevice: An electric flow storage device is a device in which electrical energy is stored and from which energy may be progressively released.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricFlowTreatmentDevice: An electric flow treatment device is used to remove unwanted matter from an electric or electronic signal in a flow distribution system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricGenerator: An electric generator is an engine that is a machine for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricMotor: An electric motor is an engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElectricTimeControl: An electric time control is a device that applies control to the provision or flow of electrical energy over time.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ElementAssembly: The IfcElementAssembly represents complex element assemblies aggregated from several elements, such as discrete elements, building elements, or other elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_EnergyConversionDevice: A device within a distribution system that converts energy or transfers heat.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Engine: An engine is a device that converts fuel into mechanical energy through combustion.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_EvaporativeCooler: An evaporative cooler is a device that cools air by saturating it with water vapor.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Evaporator: An evaporator is a device in which a liquid refrigerent is vaporized and absorbs heat from the surrounding fluid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Event: An IfcEvent is something that happens that triggers an action or response.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ExternalSpatialElement: The external spatial element defines external regions at the building site.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Facility: A built facility, such as a building, bridge, railway, road, or marine facility.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FacilityPartCommon: A part that is not clearly part of one domain but is a hybrid and has shared responsibilities in multiple domains.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Fan: A fan is a device which imparts mechanical work on a gas.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Fastener: Representations of fixing parts which are used as fasteners to connect or join elements with other elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Filter: A filter is an apparatus used to remove particulate or gaseous matter from fluids and gases.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FireSuppressionTerminal: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowController: An element that regulates flow through a distribution system, such as a damper, valve, switch, or relay.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowFitting: The distribution flow element IfcFlowFitting defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowInstrument: An instrument displaying a system property at a point or the difference in that property between two points.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowMeter: A flow meter is a device that is used to measure the flow rate in a system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowMovingDevice: A device that moves or circulates a liquid or gas through a distribution system, such as a pump or fan.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowSegment: The distribution flow element IfcFlowSegment defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowStorageDevice: A device used for temporary storage within a distribution system, such as a tank.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowTerminal: A permanently attached endpoint or starting point of a distribution system, such as an air outlet, drain, or sink.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FlowTreatmentDevice: A distribution-system device that removes unwanted material from a liquid or gas.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Footing: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_FurnishingElement: A furnishing element is a generalization of all furniture related objects.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Furniture: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_GeographicElement: An IfcGeographicElement is a generalization of all elements within a geographical landscape.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Geomodel: Representation of the concept of a volumetric geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Geoslice: Representation of the concept of a sectional planar geological and geotechnical model, usually an interpretation but sometimes created direct from ground penetrating measurement.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_GeotechnicalStratum: A discrete, approximately homogeneous geological feature represented as a solid, a top surface, or voxels.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Grid: A planar design grid positioned in three-dimensional space to locate structural and other design elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Group: An arbitrary grouping of objects for a shared purpose or organizational context.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_HeatExchanger: A heat exchanger is a device used to provide heat transfer between non-mixing media such as plate and shell and tube heat exchangers.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Humidifier: A humidifier is a device that adds moisture into the air.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ImpactProtectionDevice: An impact protection device is a component used to protect other built elements from kinetic damage.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Interceptor: A gravity drainage device that retains unwanted or hazardous matter while allowing sewage or other liquids to discharge.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Inventory: An inventory is a list of items within an enterprise.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_JunctionBox: A junction box is an enclosure within which cables are connected.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Kerb: A border of stone, concrete or other rigid material formed at the edge of the carriageway or footway.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_LaborResource: An IfcLaborResource is used in construction with particular skills or crafts required to perform certain types of construction or management related work.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Lamp: A lamp is an artificial light source such as a light bulb or tube.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_LightFixture: A housing for one or more lamps, optionally including devices that control or modify their light output.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_LinearElement: A generalization of all linear elements that are parts of an alignment.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_LinearPositioningElement: An IfcLinearPositioningElement is an entity describing positioning according to a curve.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_LiquidTerminal: An endpoint or starting point where a liquid distribution system exchanges liquid with its external environment.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MarineFacility: A major facility in the ports and waterways domain, such as a quay, jetty, shipyard, or breakwater.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MechanicalFastener: A component that mechanically joins building elements or their parts.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MedicalDevice: A medical device is attached to a medical piping system and operates upon medical gases to perform a specific function.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Member: An IfcMember is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MobileTelecommunicationsAppliance: A mobile telecommunications appliance is a device that transmits, converts, amplifies or receives signals used in mobile networks.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MooringDevice: An active or passive component used to secure a vessel, such as a bollard or quick-release hook.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_MotorConnection: A motor connection provides the means for connecting a motor as the driving device to the driven device.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_NavigationElement: An active or passive component providing navigational instructions or warnings to vessels, such as a buoy or beacon.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Occupant: An actor identifying the form of occupancy of a property.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_OpeningElement: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Outlet: An outlet is a device installed at a point to receive one or more inserted plugs for electrical power or communications.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Pavement: A road or paved-area element providing an even load-carrying surface for vehicles or pedestrians, usually composed of several courses.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_PerformanceHistory: IfcPerformanceHistory is used to document the actual performance of an occurrence instance over time.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Permit: A permit is a permission to perform work in places and on artifacts where regulatory, security or other access restrictions apply.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Pile: A slender foundation member embedded into the ground to support a load.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_PipeFitting: A junction or transition connecting pipe segments and changing flow characteristics such as direction or flow rate.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_PipeSegment: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Plate: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Procedure: An IfcProcedure is a logical set of actions to be taken in response to an event or to cause an event to occur.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Project: IfcProject establishes the context for information to be exchanged or shared, and it may represent a construction project but does not have to.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ProjectLibrary: An IfcProjectLibrary collects all library elements that are included within a referenced project data set.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ProjectOrder: A project order is a directive to purchase products and/or perform work, such as for construction or facilities management.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ProjectionElement: The projection element is a specialization of the general feature element to represent projections applied to building elements.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ProtectiveDevice: A protective device breaks an electrical circuit when a stated electric current that passes through it is exceeded.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ProtectiveDeviceTrippingUnit: A device that triggers a separate circuit-breaking unit when current exceeds a specified level.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Pump: A pump is a device which imparts mechanical work on fluids or slurries to move them through a channel or pipeline.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Rail: A rail is a predominately linear built element that has a special section profile.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Railing: A frame assembly beside pedestrian or vehicle circulation spaces or boundaries, used in place of or together with walls.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Railway: An IfcRailway is a spatial structure element as a route from one location to another for guided passage of wheeled vehicles on rails.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Ramp: An inclined passage linking levels at different elevations.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_RampFlight: A single inclined ramp segment connecting landings, floors, or slabs at different elevations.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Referent: IfcReferent defines a position at a particular offset along an alignment curve.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ReinforcedSoil: Soil reinforced or stabilized by some mechanical or chemical method.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ReinforcingBar: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ReinforcingMesh: A welded grid of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars, commonly used to reinforce concrete slabs.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Road: A route built on land to allow travel from one location to another, including highways, streets, cycle and foot paths, but excluding railways.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Roof: The top covering of a building, protecting it from weather.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SanitaryTerminal: A fixed water-related appliance or terminal for drinking, cleaning, or foul-water disposal, including equipment directly serving it.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Sensor: A device that measures a physical quantity and converts the measurement into a readable signal.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_ShadingDevice: A purpose-built device that limits sunlight, natural light, or visibility.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Sign: A sign is a notice on display that gives information or instructions in a written, symbolic or other form.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Signal: A signal is an active device that conveys information or instructions to users, by means of an audio, visual signal or a combination of both.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Site: A site is a defined area of land, possibly covered with water, on which the project construction is to be completed.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Slab: A slab is a component of the construction that may enclose a space vertically.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SolarDevice: A solar device converts solar radiation into other energy such as electric current or thermal energy.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Space: A space represents an area or volume bounded actually or theoretically.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SpaceHeater: A device that heats a limited space through radiation or natural convection using electricity, steam, or hot water.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SpatialZone: A spatial zone is a non-hierarchical and potentially overlapping decomposition of the project under some functional consideration.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StackTerminal: A terminal at the top of a ventilating stack or rainwater pipe, providing protection or collecting discharge from guttering.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Stair: A stair is a vertical passageway allowing occupants to walk (step) from one floor level to another floor level at a different elevation.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StairFlight: A stair flight is an assembly of building components in a single "run" of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing).
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralAnalysisModel: The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is used to assemble all information needed to represent a structural analysis model.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralCurveAction: A structural curve action defines an action which is distributed over a curve.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralCurveConnection: A linear structural-analysis connection or support where surface members meet along an edge.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralCurveMember: A linear structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a beam, column, or rod.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralCurveReaction: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a curve.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralLinearAction: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a curve.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralLoadCase: A load case is a load group, commonly used to group loads from the same action source.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralLoadGroup: The entity IfcStructuralLoadGroup is used to structure the physical impacts.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralPlanarAction: This entity defines an action with constant value which is distributed over a surface.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralPointAction: This entity defines an action which acts on a point.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralPointConnection: Instances of IfcStructuralPointConnection describe structural nodes or point supports.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralPointReaction: This entity defines a reaction which occurs at a point.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralResultGroup: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralResultGroup are used to group results of structural analysis calculations and to capture the connection to the underlying basic load group.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralSurfaceAction: This entity defines an action which is distributed over a surface.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralSurfaceConnection: A surface structural-analysis connection or support where members meet over a face.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralSurfaceMember: A surface structural-analysis idealization of a member such as a slab, wall, or shell.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_StructuralSurfaceReaction: This entity defines a reaction which occurs distributed over a surface.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SubContractResource: IfcSubContractResource is a construction resource needed in a construction process that represents a sub-contractor.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SurfaceFeature: A surface feature is a modification at (onto, or into) of the surface of an element.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SwitchingDevice: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_System: A collection of related parts organized to perform a common function or provide a service.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_SystemFurnitureElement: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Tank: A tank is a vessel or container in which a fluid or gas is stored for later use.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Task: An IfcTask is an identifiable unit of work to be carried out in a construction project.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Tendon: A tensioned steel wire, cable, bar, rod, or strand used to prestress concrete.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_TendonAnchor: A tendon anchor is the end connection for tendons in prestressed or posttensioned concrete.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_TendonConduit: A TendonConduit represents the components of the conduit system for tendons embedded in concrete structure.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_TrackElement: A track element is a built element used specifically in the track domain in railway.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Transformer: A transformer is an inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_TransportElement: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a Facility.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_TubeBundle: An assembly of tubes used for heat transfer within equipment such as a chiller or coil.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_UnitaryControlElement: A unitary control element combines a number of control components into a single product, such as a thermostat or humidistat.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_UnitaryEquipment: Unitary equipment typically combine a number of components into a single product, such as air handlers, pre-packaged rooftop air-conditioning units, heat pumps, and split systems.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Valve: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Vehicle: Piece of equipment designed to transport people or cargo.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_VibrationDamper: A vibration damper is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration in a structure by dissipating kinetic energy.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_VibrationIsolator: A vibration isolator is a device used to minimize the effects of vibration transmissibility in a structure.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_VirtualElement: A virtual element is a special element used to provide imaginary, placeholder, or provisional areas, volumes, and boundaries.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_VoidingFeature: A voiding feature is a modification of an element which reduces its volume.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Wall: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_WasteTerminal: A device that collects or intercepts waste from sanitary terminals or other equipment and discharges it into a drainage system.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Window: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_WorkCalendar: An IfcWorkCalendar defines working and non-working time periods for tasks and resources.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_WorkPlan: An IfcWorkPlan represents work plans in a construction or a facilities management project.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_WorkSchedule: An IfcWorkSchedule represents a task schedule of a work plan, which in turn can contain a set of schedules for different purposes.
IFC4X3_ADD2.View_Zone: A zone is a group of spaces, partial spaces or other zones.
